channel.title: Enshrouded Wiki
channel.description: An unofficial player-made guide for Enshrouded 1.0: Cinder's Cradle, Sparkworks, 1.0 builds and the post-1.0 beginner route — verified against the 1.0 patch notes and dated.

item.title: Enshrouded 1.0 Beginner Guide — Your Route Into Cinder's Cradle
item.description: The post-1.0 beginner route for Enshrouded: what 1.0 changed, the order to progress in, and how to prepare for the new endgame region Cinder's Cradle.

item.title: Cinder's Cradle Guide — Enshrouded's Final Region (1.0)
item.description: Cinder's Cradle is Enshrouded's final region, opened by 1.0: a volcanic endgame zone tuned for the new level cap of 50. What it holds, and how to prepare.

item.title: Sparkworks Guide — Enshrouded's New 1.0 System
item.description: Sparkworks is the new system Enshrouded 1.0 shipped on October 15, 2026, tied to endgame progression. What it is, how it fits the loop, what is being verified.

item.title: Enshrouded 1.0 Builds & Classes — What Changed and Which Archetypes Gained
item.description: What 1.0 did to every build archetype: nine new spells, eternal upgrades, a cap of 50 — and the archetypes with the most to gain. Verified against the 1.0 notes.
